title: TUESDAY GRIND
subtitle: TWENTY MINUTES. NO NEGOTIATING.
intro: RIGHT THEN YOU MAGNIFICENT WRECK. PHONE DOWN AFTER THIS SENTENCE. WE ARE WORKING.
completion: THAT IS THE LOT. YOU DID NOT DIE. I AM ALMOST IMPRESSED. WATER. NOW.

exercises.name: JUMPING JACKS
exercises.instruction: FORTY-FIVE SECONDS OF JUMPING JACKS. ARMS ABOVE THE HEAD. DO NOT LOOK AT ME LIKE THAT.
exercises.midCue: KEEP THOSE FEET MOVING. I CAN SEE YOU SOFTENING.
exercises.endCue: TIME. SHAKE IT OUT. DO NOT SIT.
exercises.restCue: FIFTEEN SECONDS. BREATHE THROUGH YOUR NOSE LIKE A PERSON.

exercises.name: PUSH-UPS
exercises.instruction: TEN PUSH-UPS. CHEST TO THE FLOOR. KNEES ARE LEGAL IF THE FULL ONES TURN INTO A WORM.
exercises.completeCue: THAT WILL DO. ON YOUR FEET.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY SECONDS. NEXT ONE IS WORSE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS
exercises.instruction: FIFTEEN SQUATS. HIPS BACK. CHEST UP. IF I CANNOT SEE DEPTH I SHALL PRETEND I DID NOT NOTICE AND THEN NOTICE.
exercises.completeCue: GOOD. YOU STILL HAVE KNEES. LUCKY YOU.

exercises.name: PLANK
exercises.instruction: FORTY SECONDS OF PLANK. STRAIGHT LINE. HIPS ARE NOT A HAMMOCK.
exercises.midCue: STILL A STRAIGHT LINE. I AM WATCHING THE HIPS.
exercises.endCue: DOWN. CAREFULLY. YOU ARE NOT A SACK OF SPUDS.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.instruction: TWELVE GLUTE BRIDGES. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. YES IT LOOKS SILLY. DO IT ANYWAY.

exercises.name: FAST MARCH ON THE SPOT
exercises.instruction: THIRTY SECONDS. HIGH KNEES IF YOU HAVE THEM. A BRISK MARCH IF YOU DO NOT. ARMS PUMPING.
exercises.midCue: FASTER THAN THE KETTLE. NOT FASTER THAN SENSE.
